| g15922 | HKT1                      | Na⁺ transporter controlling shoot–root Na⁺ recirculation                    | Same locus/haplotype block as above; reinforces that **Na⁺ homeostasis** is under spatially varying selection.                                                                                                                                                                             |

| g24686 | CIPK12                    | Ca²⁺-regulated protein kinase                                               | General Ca²⁺-dependent stress signaling; often implicated in **salt/osmotic and ABA-related responses**. | g29431 | CIPK12                    | Ca²⁺-regulated protein kinase                                               | Duplicate hit for same pathway; strengthens the signal that **Ca²⁺/CIPK signaling** is under landscape selection.                                                                                                                                                                          |

| g29473 | NIP1-1                    | Nodulin-like aquaporin (water/small solute channel)                         | Aquaporins modulate **water and small solute movement** across membranes. Variation here could track **soil moisture, inundation depth/length, or potentially metalloids** in different reaches (backwater vs levee vs upland).                                                            |

| g16203 | AHA8                      | Plasma-membrane H⁺-ATPase                                                   | H⁺ pumping drives **nutrient uptake, ion balance, and apoplastic pH**. | g416   | STP13                     | Hexose/H⁺ symporter at plasma membrane                                      | High-affinity hexose uptake. Good candidate for adaptation of **carbon allocation and sugar import** under different light regimes, flood stress, or pathogen pressures (sugar availability at infection sites).                                                                           |

| g35511 | NCED6                     | 9-cis-epoxycarotenoid dioxygenase (ABA biosynthesis, seed dormancy)         | Strong candidate for **seed dormancy and germination timing**. Populations along the river likely differ in the timing of safe sites (drawdown vs disturbance); NCED6 variation could tune **ABA levels and dormancy depth**, affecting emergence relative to flood regime.                |

| g15243 | LDL1                      | H3K4 demethylase; represses FLC/FWA, controls seed dormancy                 | Epigenetic regulator of **flowering time and primary seed dormancy**. Along with NCED6 could underlie **clines in germination and flowering phenology** matching flood/disturbance timing.                                                                                                 |

| g23197 | LDL2                      | LDL1-like H3K4 demethylase                                                  | Paralog with partially redundant roles in **FLC regulation and dormancy**. Having both LDL1/2 hit supports **epigenetic tuning of phenology and dormancy** across the landscape.                                                                                                           |

| g17284 | NLP6                      | NIN-like transcription factor in nitrate signaling                          | N-sensing regulator. Differences here make sense if your environmental predictors include **soil nitrate, agricultural runoff, or flood-delivered nutrient pulses**; could mediate local adaptation in growth response to nutrient pulses.                                                 |

| g32500 | PIN4                      | Auxin efflux carrier                                                        | Controls auxin distribution, especially in roots. Great candidate for **root architecture and gravitropic responses**, e.g., deeper vs shallower rooting in sites differing in **water table depth, sediment stability, or flood scour**.                                                  |

| g175   | KNAT6                     | KNOX homeobox controlling meristem maintenance & organ separation           | Affects **shoot architecture and meristem behavior**. Could contribute to differences in **branching, number of flowering stems, and vegetative vs reproductive investment**, matching disturbance frequency (e.g., annually scoured vs more stable sites).                                |

| g26715 | PCN                       | WD-repeat protein integrating auxin signaling in SAM/RAM                    | Integrates **auxin signaling in shoot/root meristems**. Along with PIN4 and KNAT6, points to local adaptation in **plant form (height, branching, root system)** relevant to competition and hydrology.                                                                                    |

| g17129 | PHB3                      | Mitochondrial prohibitin; NO/ROS, ethylene-related signaling                | Links **mitochondrial function, ROS, NO, and ethylene signaling**. Very plausible for adaptation to **hypoxia/anoxia and re-oxygenation** following floods, where mitochondrial integrity and ROS management matter.                                                                       |

| g1117  | NDA1                      | Alternative NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (non-proton-pumping)                      | Part of **alternative respiratory pathway**. Good candidate for **tolerance to low O₂ or high redox stress** (flooded soils, waterlogging) and for managing ROS during re-aeration.                                                                                                        |

| g1297  | NUDT15                    | CoA-diphosphatase removing oxidized CoA                                     | Detoxifies **oxidized CoA**, tied to oxidative stress and mitochondrial metabolism. Fits a theme of **redox management under flooding/drying cycles**. Nearby duplicate (g1298, g29430) suggests a robust signal in this region.                                                           |

| g29418 | GUN4                      | Tetrapyrrole-binding protein; regulates Mg-chelatase & retrograde signaling | Key regulator of **chlorophyll synthesis and plastid-to-nucleus signaling**. Variation could reflect adaptation to **light environment (open sandbar vs vegetated levee)** or **photodamage risk under shallower, clearer water vs shaded backwaters**.                                    |

| g7571  | LHCB7                     | Light-harvesting complex protein with role in NPQ                           | Modulates **non-photochemical quenching (energy dissipation)**. Nice candidate for **differences in high-light vs shaded conditions**, or fluctuating light associated with canopy cover and water reflection.                                                                             |

| g32467 | FLN2                      | Fructokinase-like; required for chloroplast gene expression                 | Essential for proper **chloroplast development and PEP-dependent transcription**. Together with GUN4/LHCB7 suggests a block of selection on **photosynthetic machinery** along light or stress gradients.                                                                                  |

| g29428 | TPT                       | Triose-phosphate/phosphate translocator (chloroplast export)                | Exports **triose phosphates from chloroplast to cytosol**; central to carbon partitioning. Good candidate for adaptation to **productivity differences**, e.g., nutrient-rich vs nutrient-poor sites or shifts in daylength/temperature along the river.                                   |

| g7562  | OEP21B                    | Chloroplast outer envelope anion channel for triose-P/3-PGA/Pi              | Controls flux of phosphorylated metabolites between chloroplast and cytosol. | g7564  | MCD1                      | Chloroplast division positioning factor                                     | Regulates **chloroplast number and size**. Could underlie subtle differences in **photosynthetic capacity, plasticity under high light/low light, or recovery from stress** between populations.                                                                                           |

| g28356 | RPPL1                     | RPP13-like NB-LRR disease resistance protein                                | Strong candidate for **local pathogen adaptation** (soilborne or foliar). Pathogen communities can vary with **flood regime, vegetation neighbors, and land use**, so spatially varying selection on R genes makes sense.                                                                  |

| g29472 | ROQ1                      | NB-LRR R protein with NADase activity                                       | Another R gene; NADase activity activates defense and PCD. Together with RPPL1 and RUN1 (below) indicates **strong immune-related selection**, possibly from **microbial communities structured by hydrology or disturbance**.                                                             |

| g7549  | RUN1                      | NB-LRR R protein with NADase activity                                       | Known to confer mildew resistance in grape. | g7558  | MLO-H1                    | MLO family membrane protein (defense/susceptibility)                        | MLOs are classic **powdery mildew susceptibility genes**; loss-of-function often confers resistance. | g7560  | MLO5                      | MLO-like protein (defense & cell death modulation)                          | Another MLO; strengthens the case for **pathogen-driven local adaptation** (perhaps fungi favored by particular hydrologic niches).                                                                                                                                                        |

| g29424 | ABCG29                    | ABC transporter G family, defense-related                                   | Likely exports specialized metabolites (defense compounds, antimicrobial molecules, or cuticular components). | g33447 | CYP83B1                   | P450 in indole glucosinolate and auxin metabolism                           | Central to **indole glucosinolate biosynthesis and auxin homeostasis**. | g18104 | PLP7                      | Patatin-like lipase; affects oxylipins, defense & cell elongation           | Lipase connected to **oxylipin metabolism, cell death, and disease resistance**. | g1101  | At4g20840 (BBE-like 21)   | Berberine-bridge-enzyme-like oxidoreductase                                 | BBE-like proteins often act in **cell wall–associated or specialized metabolism** (including defense compounds/lignans). Plausible candidate for **cell-wall reinforcement or defense chemistry** in areas differing in mechanical stress (flood scouring) or herbivore/pathogen pressure. |

| g26515 | BXL7                      | β-D-xylosidase (cell wall remodeling)                                       | Cell-wall hydrolase likely acting on **hemicelluloses**. Could mediate differences in **stem/leaf mechanical properties**, lodging resistance, or **growth under frequent flooding and sediment movement**.                                                                                |

| g6035  | DPEP                      | Disproportionating enzyme / 4-α-glucanotransferase (starch metabolism)      | Involved in **starch breakdown and remodeling**.
